blockingIssues.description: The updated tests only assert the initial `Loading email queue` skeleton path. They do not verify the stale-data/tab-enter refetch indicator (`Refreshing email queue` / `Refreshing queued jobs…` with `aria-busy="true"`) that the feature's expected behavior calls out, so the deterministic accessible marker behavior is not actually protected by automated regression coverage.

`retryEmailDelivery` is called with `pendingRetryAttempt.messageId`, but the new API contract requires `deliveryLogId` (the `email_delivery_log.id`) and rejects non-UUID values. Delivery-log attempts expose `messageId` as the provider message identifier, so real retry actions will POST the wrong ID and receive `400 INVALID_REQUEST` instead of resending the failed/bounced email.

`bookingService.retryEmailDelivery` is invoked with `{ deliveryLogId: pendingRetryAttempt.messageId }`, but the feature contract and service method both expect a delivery-log entry ID, not the provider message ID. The same mismatch is baked into the new tests. Because `OpsEmailDeliveryAttemptDTO.messageId` is a provider message ID, retries can target the wrong record or be rejected entirely when the API validates against the actual delivery-log row id.

Queue manual refresh only passes `refreshKey={tab === 'queue' ? manualRefreshNonce : 0}`. `manualRefreshNonce` is incremented for every manual refresh click, including on other tabs, but once the user is already on Queue the prop can remain unchanged between renders after switching into the tab with a non-zero nonce. Because `OpsEmailQueuePanel` only refetches inside `useEffect(...,[enabled, query, refreshKey])`, repeated manual refresh clicks while staying on Queue can stop triggering refetches, so the 'Refresh current tab' requirement is not reliably met for the active Queue tab.

nonBlockingIssues.description: Auto-refresh test coverage only exercises the Delivery Log tab. There is no regression test showing that switching to Queue or Analytics with auto-refresh enabled continues polling/refetching the newly active tab, even though this is explicitly required by the feature's expected behavior.

appliedUpdates.description: The delivery-log attempt DTO used by the Email Delivery UI does not expose the underlying `email_delivery_log.id`, even though the retry API contract is keyed by that ID. This mismatch forced the worker to wire the client to `messageId`, which is a different field with different semantics.
